description: Prompts that should and should not load the skill. should_trigger true means the skill must load; false means it must not.

tests.prompt: Draw the partitions for the level 1 offices in the open drawing: two rooms, 4 7/8 in studs, a door into each.
In Revit, make a door schedule with mark, type, width, height and fire rating.
Set up this new DWG to our office CAD standard: layers, text styles, dim styles, units.
Put the ground floor plan and the RCP on sheet A101 and export the issue set to PDF.
Audit this drawing against the standard and fix the layers and the colours that aren't ByLayer.
The xrefs in this plan are all broken since we moved the project folder. Can you repair them?
I need an FF&E schedule with counts from the furniture blocks in my fit-out plan.
Add finish codes to the rooms in the Revit model and build a room finish schedule.
Delete the unplaced rooms and the working views nobody put on a sheet in our central model.
Lay out a 7.5 m by 6 m structural grid with levels at 0, 4200 and 8400 in the model.
Count the accessible WCs in this plan for my accessibility review and mark my findings with leaders.
Plant the trees on the landscape plan at their spread and give me a planting schedule from the blocks.
Place 24 desks and task chairs on level 2 of the Revit model, in rows of six facing the windows.
Hatch the terrace paving with herringbone and tell me the paved area, leaving out the tree pits.
Check the wheelchair turning circle and the door approach in WC 104 against the furniture and fittings.
Change the heights of our Single-Flush door family to 2100 and add an 826 wide type.
Set the walls we're keeping to Existing, mark the two we're knocking out as demolished, and set up existing, demo and proposed plans.
Some of the doors on level 1 are borrowed by another user in our central model. Update the fire ratings on the rest.
Look at sheet A-201 and tell me if any tags overlap or anything we added sits outside the crop.
Export the rooms with their department, area and finishes to a CSV for the FM team, and the Navisworks file for coordination.
Set out the 600 by 600 ceiling grid in the meeting room so the border tiles are balanced, and move the existing lights to the tile centres.
Purge the unused families and materials from the model, but show me the list before deleting anything.
Write a Python function that reads a CSV of room areas and sums them by department.
Explain the difference between a load-bearing wall and a partition wall.
Make a photoreal rendering of my living room concept with warm evening light.
Design a landing page for my architecture studio with a project gallery.
Help me write a fee proposal email to a client for a kitchen refit.
Size the ductwork and the heat pump for a three-storey office.
Summarise this PDF of the building regulations part M for me.
Fix the failing unit tests in my React app.
Create a 3D-printable model of a chair in STL format.
What is the history of the Bauhaus movement?
Calculate the cut and fill volumes for this site from the survey contours.
Make me a mood board for a Scandinavian-style hotel lobby.
Suggest a colour palette and furniture style for a small café interior.
Convert this list of room areas from square feet to square metres.
